labels: A practice jacket crosses one front panel over the other at the torso and is held at the waist by a visibly knotted fabric belt above loose trousers.; 훈련용 상의의 두 앞섶이 몸 앞에서 교차하고 헐렁한 바지 위 허리에는 매듭진 천 띠가 둘러진다.
definition: Complete optional school-life visual realization: A practice jacket crosses one front panel over the other at the torso and is held at the waist by a visibly knotted fabric belt above loose trousers.
aliases: 무도복의 교차 여밈
